name: Nori Cam
description: A Chrome extension camera app with text and image overlays, basic and advanced filters, zoom, and all the essentials you need for calls and recordings.

privacy.label: Camera Access
privacy.text: Nori Cam requires access to your camera to provide virtual background and video enhancement features. This video processing is performed entirely locally on your device. No video or image data is ever transmitted to our servers or any third parties.

privacy.label: Settings
privacy.text: We store your preferences (e.g., chosen filters, backgrounds) locally in your browser's storage.

name: Pomori
